top_signals.title: Bond Selloff Fades as Oil Cools, Lifting Stocks
top_signals.summary:
The final stretch of a jittery week on Wall Street saw a rebound in stocks as oil prices fell, easing a selloff in bonds that had roiled financial markets around the world.
Darius Dale, founder and CEO at 42 Macro gives his outlook on equities and the fading bond selloff. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Untapped Value of Tennis Stars
top_signals.summary: Winners Alliance CEO Ahmad Nassar joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why professional tennis needs wholesale reform. He says the sport remains too fragmented, and he explains how pooling player rights can unlock new commercial opportunities. (Source: Bloomberg)
